TITLE: Kashmir
HERO_SUBTEXT: Paradise on Earth wrapped in the breathtaking Himalayas.
WHY_VISIT_PARA: Kashmir's surreal landscapes feel like stepping into an ancient painting. Experience profound tranquility gliding across mirrored lakes in a magnificent wooden houseboat.
BULLET_1: Luxurious heritage houseboats on the serene Dal Lake
BULLET_2: World-class skiing down the slopes of Gulmarg
BULLET_3: Vibrant Mughal gardens blooming with exotic flowers
BULLET_4: Exclusive artisanal cashmere and intricate saffron trades
BULLET_5: Trekking trails through remote alpine meadows
EXP_1_PARA: Glide gracefully across Dal Lake as the setting sun reflects off snowy peaks.
EXP_2_PARA: Experience the highest gondola rides atop Gulmarg.
EXP_3_PARA: Lose yourself in the fragrance of ancient terraced Mughal landscapes.
STORY_PARA: In Kashmir, the air is crisp, the hospitality is warm, and time seems frozen in a world of absolute purity.

TITLE: Leh Ladakh
HERO_SUBTEXT: Venture into the pristine silence of the high-altitude desert.
WHY_VISIT_PARA: Ladakh is a mystical land where azure skies perfectly frame barren mountains and vibrant prayer flags flutter in the wind. This high-altitude desert challenges the adventurous while providing incredibly luxurious tented camps.
BULLET_1: Glamping under the endless canopy of the Milky Way
BULLET_2: Awe-inspiring vistas at the bright blue Pangong Lake
BULLET_3: Conquering Khardung La, one of the world's highest motorable passes
BULLET_4: Centuries-old Tibetan monasteries hanging on cliff sides
BULLET_5: Charming encounters with elusive Himalayan wildlife
EXP_1_PARA: Witness the mirror-like perfection of Pangong Tso.
EXP_2_PARA: Hear the deep rolling chants echoing from Thiksey Monastery.
EXP_3_PARA: Ride a double-humped camel through the surreal Nubra Valley dunes.
STORY_PARA: Breathing in the thin, pure mountain air humbling your spirit all at once.

TITLE: Himachal Pradesh
HERO_SUBTEXT: Discover the majestic valleys of the gods.
WHY_VISIT_PARA: Nestled deep in the western Himalayas, Himachal Pradesh boasts enchanting valleys covered in thick emerald pine and sparkling snow. Retreat to luxury heritage cottages perched beautifully upon misty mountain cliffs.
BULLET_1: Boutique woodland cottages providing breathtaking panoramas
BULLET_2: Iconic lush valleys like Kullu, Manali, and Spiti
BULLET_3: Gourmet mountain dining starring fresh regional produce
BULLET_4: Adrenaline-fueled river rafting and elevated paragliding
BULLET_5: Charming, historic tea estates nestled in Kangra
EXP_1_PARA: Walk silently through apple orchards that carpet mountainsides.
EXP_2_PARA: Listen to the quiet prayers flowing from hilltop monasteries.
EXP_3_PARA: Navigate the soaring Rohtang Pass, a pure white heaven.
STORY_PARA: Morning tea arrives as the valley clears of mist. Absolute perfection.

TITLE: Kerala
HERO_SUBTEXT: Sail into the serene heart of God's Own Country.
WHY_VISIT_PARA: Glide gracefully along emerald backwaters while ensconced safely within a traditional luxury houseboat. Kerala offers an ethereal retreat surrounded by rich greenery and fragrant spice plantations.
BULLET_5: Vibrant local flavors bursting with fresh coconut
EXP_1_PARA: Drift slowly under sleepy palm canopies.
EXP_2_PARA: Rejuvenate completely in premium wellness sanctuaries.
EXP_3_PARA: Spend mornings tasting the finest tea atop rolling hills.
STORY_PARA: A profound stillness that coax you into complete inner peace.

TITLE: Goa
HERO_SUBTEXT: A mesmerizing cocktail of luxury, heritage, and shores.
WHY_VISIT_PARA: Beyond the vibrant coastline lies a Goa of unmatched luxury. Discover hidden boutique villas swathed in Portuguese heritage, where lazy afternoons effortlessly melt into exquisite evenings.
BULLET_1: Private beach coves lined by five-star resorts
BULLET_3: Sophisticated beach clubs and exclusive dining spots
BULLET_4: Pristine yacht charters across the Arabian Sea
BULLET_5: Tranquil yoga sanctuaries wrapped deep in tropical rainforests
EXP_1_PARA: Lounge on immaculate sands with a chilled drink.
EXP_2_PARA: Explore old, majestic churches painted beautiful white.
EXP_3_PARA: Feast on fresh seafood curated by renowned chefs.
STORY_PARA: Time doesn’t rule here. The only schedule is set by glowing orange sunsets.

TITLE: Ooty
HERO_SUBTEXT: Retreat to the aristocratic mist of the Nilgiris.
WHY_VISIT_PARA: Step into a world reminiscent of classic colonial elegance. Relax beside warm stone fireplaces inside magnificent heritage planters' mansions.
BULLET_2: Scenic journeys on the historic train
EXP_1_PARA: Immerse yourself in history inside elegant luxury bungalows.
EXP_2_PARA: Wind incredibly through towering forests of pine.
EXP_3_PARA: Trek quietly along fragrant tea plantations.
STORY_PARA: With tea in hand, observing the fog roll gently, life feels incredibly light.

TITLE: Delhi
HERO_SUBTEXT: The spectacular crossroads of ancient empires and modern luxury.
WHY_VISIT_PARA: Walk the incredible corridors of ancient forts before unwinding in sophisticated suites. It is a city of layered history and lavish energy.
EXP_1_PARA: Marvel at the spectacular red sandstone arches of the Red Fort.
EXP_2_PARA: Take a serene drive through the geometries of New Delhi.
EXP_3_PARA: Feast on rich curries crafted by master chefs.
STORY_PARA: Witness a city that has conquered time—standing proudly alive.

TITLE: Mumbai
HERO_SUBTEXT: The city of glittering dreams and unyielding ambition.
WHY_VISIT_PARA: Sleep wrapped in the legendary heritage of sea-facing iconic hotels, dine over glittering skylines, and dive into the glamorous whirlwind of Bollywood.
BULLET_1: Staying at timeless properties like the Taj Mahal Palace
BULLET_2: Exclusive rooftop parties viewing Marine Drive
BULLET_3: Gourmet coastal cuisine served in high-fashion districts
EXP_1_PARA: Step back into elegant 19th-century South Mumbai.
EXP_2_PARA: Gaze over stunning lights tracing the ocean bay.
EXP_3_PARA: Leave the hustle behind on a luxury sailboat.
STORY_PARA: Every night promises a brilliant glow, wrapping its visitors in a glamorous spell.

TITLE: Gujarat
HERO_SUBTEXT: A majestic land of legends, lions, and vast white deserts.
WHY_VISIT_PARA: Gujarat invites you to experience supreme luxury tents under moonlit skies and breathtaking close encounters with Asiatic lions.
BULLET_1: Glamorous stays upon the White Rann desert
BULLET_2: Exclusive safaris safely exploring the regal Gir lions
BULLET_5: Vibrant traditional textiles and colorful handicrafts
EXP_1_PARA: Watch infinite crystal plains gleam stunningly beneath the moon.
EXP_2_PARA: Indulge your senses walking the grand corridors of immense historic palaces.
EXP_3_PARA: Experience immense peace viewing the intricate carvings.
STORY_PARA: In Gujarat, the setting sun casts a mystical glow over grounding ancient lands.
